categories_note: 34 items do not need categories; actions group them

tiers.P0: REAL on a live path, with the evidence named
tiers.P1: REAL but not live, or a gate suite

priority.live_use_for_p0: a person's or the mini's run crashes or gives wrong output today

age.from: the first reporter record listing the suite (records start 2026-09-20)

owners.source: the code under test: components/CLAUDE.md Residents row, or the build folder's owner

walls: a machine delete or external send
media over the size limit in git
brands/ read-only to machines this phase

lane_conditions.status: the team is the triage owner and sits in the lead seat
now: a re-pin or test fix the team cards and dispatches
an approval or ruling the team types
lane_conditions.guard: never loosen or delete an assertion beyond the named pin; the lead reviews every assertion change (TI-23 (red-test fixes on GLM))

doer_tags.now: the triage owner can do it alone, today, within the lane conditions
doer_tags.after: the triage owner can do it once a ruling lands (the action's own, or the pending 'apply a ruled default, owner told' ruling)
doer_tags.draft: the triage owner prepares it; the owner lands it (owner's work in flight, a live path, or large)
doer_tags.owner: only the owner can do it (a design call, knowledge or an act only they have)

context_hook.note: red tests live in build folders; whether a build folder's CLAUDE.md should import a context file is open

routes.glm: test-only re-pins and fixes (TI-23 (red-test fixes on GLM)): only test files change; 2–3 test files allowed
routes.claude: code on shared surfaces, the owner's code, engine and page code

cadence: on each reporter change, or weekly (open)
open_gaps: the reporter carries old statuses forward, so 'last red' can be stale
blocked_by: a card awaiting approval, a pending decision, or nothing (the team 'ok' on #3, 4b36a7a90)
